title: Music Recommendation with Large Language Models: Challenges, Opportunities, and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring systematic disparities in exposure across mainstream versus long-tail content using metrics like Average Recommendation Popularity (ARP) and relative popularity lift to quantify sampling-bias amplification.

Evaluating systematic disparities in exposure across stratified groups (e.g., Western versus non-Western music) and measuring cultural/linguistic coverage or geo-diversity per request to ensure fair representation of different regions.
Analyzing temporal drift, catalog recency distribution, and freshness using metrics such as Time-To-First-Surface (TTFS) and Day-0 Lift to evaluate bias toward newly released or older material.
Conducting position swap tests, verbosity attacks, and comparisons with human ground-truth judgments to detect systematic biases when LLMs are used as automatic judges for evaluating outputs.
